description: Pipeline Interactive Mode — Manual/Auto modes with Q&A, plan approval, real-time TUI streaming, CLI commands, and mandatory build/test verification

userStories.title: Add pipeline.answer command handler in daemon

acceptanceCriteria: New handler for 'pipeline.answer' command in handlers.rs

userStories.title: Add pipeline.approve and pipeline.reject command handlers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need approve/reject handlers so users can approve plans and final results in manual mode.
acceptanceCriteria: New handler for 'pipeline.approve' command: if WaitingForApproval → emit PipelinePlanApproved, transition to Running + start Implement stage; if WaitingForFinalApproval → emit PipelineFinalApproved, transition to Completed

New handler for 'pipeline.reject' command: params include feedback string; if WaitingForApproval → emit PipelinePlanRejected, restart Plan with feedback; if WaitingForFinalApproval → emit PipelineFinalRejected, increment iteration, go back to Implement with feedback
Reject checks max_iterations — if exceeded, mark Failed
Both handlers validate pipeline exists and is in expected state
Returns appropriate error for invalid state transitions
cargo build --workspace succeeds

userStories.title: Add pipeline.questions command handler

acceptanceCriteria: New handler for 'pipeline.questions' command in handlers.rs
Params: { pipeline_run_id }
Calls db::pipeline::get_pending_questions() to fetch unanswered questions
Returns { status: ok, data: { questions: [...] } } with question id, text, context
Returns empty array if no pending questions
cargo build --workspace succeeds

userStories.title: Update pipeline executor for manual mode approval gates
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the pipeline executor tokio task to pause at approval gates in manual mode and resume when approve/reject commands arrive.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline executor checks mode after Plan stage completes: if Manual → update DB status to WaitingForApproval, emit PipelinePlanReady, wait on tokio::sync::Notify
pipeline.approve handler triggers the Notify to resume executor
pipeline.reject handler triggers the Notify with rejection flag, executor restarts Plan with feedback
After Review passes in Manual mode: update DB to WaitingForFinalApproval, emit PipelineFinalApprovalReady, wait on Notify
pipeline.approve (final) triggers Notify, executor marks Completed
pipeline.reject (final) triggers Notify with feedback, executor loops back to Implement
Store Notify handle in a shared map keyed by pipeline_run_id
cargo build --workspace succeeds

userStories.title: Update pipeline_plan.md prompt for structured question output
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Plan stage prompt to instruct Claude to output questions in a structured JSON format so the daemon can parse and route them.
acceptanceCriteria: Update prompts/pipeline_plan.md: add section instructing Claude to output questions as JSON array BEFORE the plan
Question format: { "questions": [{ "question": "...", "context": "..." }] } wrapped in ```json block with a marker like PIPELINE_QUESTIONS
Prompt instructs: first explore the codebase, then ask questions about ambiguous requirements, then produce the plan
If no questions needed, skip the questions block entirely
cargo build --workspace succeeds (prompts are embedded at compile time)

userStories.title: Create auto-answerer agent prompt and spawning logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a new prompt template and agent spawning logic for the auto-answerer that searches the codebase to answer planning questions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new prompts/pipeline_auto_answer.md with variables: {question}, {context}
Prompt instructs: search the codebase using Read/Glob/Grep, find relevant code/patterns, provide a concrete answer; if not found, recommend a sensible default with rationale
Output format: { "answer": "...", "confidence": "high|medium|low", "sources": ["file paths consulted"] }
In daemon pipeline executor: when question detected in auto mode, spawn Claude process via nflow-claude with --allowedTools 'Read,Glob,Grep' --max-turns 10
Set 60 second timeout on the spawned process
Parse auto-answerer output, call db::pipeline::answer_question with answered_by='auto-agent'
If auto-answerer fails or times out: use fallback answer 'Proceed with your best judgment based on codebase analysis' and log warning
Create new agent_runs record with run_type='auto-answerer'
Emit PipelineQuestionAnswered event
cargo build --workspace succeeds

userStories.title: Detect and route questions from Plan agent stream output
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the pipeline executor to detect structured question JSON from the Plan agent's stream-json output and route them to either user or auto-answerer.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline executor parses Plan agent stream output looking for PIPELINE_QUESTIONS marker + JSON block
When questions detected: insert each into DB via insert_question(), emit PipelineQuestion events
If mode=Manual: pause execution (questions are shown to user, they answer via pipeline.answer command)
If mode=Auto: for each question, spawn auto-answerer agent (US-010), wait for all answers, then feed answers back into Plan agent context
Questions are batch-style: all questions emitted at once, all must be answered before plan continues
If no questions detected in output, proceed directly to plan completion
cargo build --workspace succeeds

userStories.title: CLI pipeline subcommand group — start, list, status, cancel, log
userStories.description: As a user, I want basic pipeline management commands in CLI.
